newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices fall with NYMEX, diffs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices fall with NYMEX, diffs.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell by 0.65 cent to over a cent Wednesday tracking NYMEX heating oil futures and softer cash differentials, traders said.

Traders said 54-grade airline-quality barrels for prompt delivery were talked in Houston at between 1.00 and 0.75 cent under January NYMEX, while in New York Harbor the were offered at 3.25 cents over the January print.
They said diffs on low sulphur 55-grade barrels weakened notionally in sympathy with the 54-grade, but talk was on the thin side.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
